description: This Java source file defines a class `ProductSearch` that provides utilities and internal classes for searching products within an e-commerce framework, including constraints for categories, features, keywords, and result sorting. It manages complex search query construction, interacts with the OFBiz entity engine, and supports detailed search constraint logic.

classes.name: ProductSearch
classes.description: Main utility class for product search functionality, including inner classes for search constraints and context management.

classes.name: ProductSearch.ProductSearchContext
classes.description: Encapsulates the state and logic for executing a product search query, including constraints, ordering, and result processing.

classes.name: ProductSearch.ProductSearchConstraint
classes.description: Abstract base class for search constraints to be applied within product searches.

classes.name: ProductSearch.CatalogConstraint
classes.description: Represents a catalog-based search constraint, filtering products based on catalog ID and associated categories.

classes.name: ProductSearch.CategoryConstraint
classes.description: Represents a category-based search constraint, including options for subcategory inclusion and exclusion.

classes.name: ProductSearch.GoodIdentificationConstraint
classes.description: Represents a good identification constraint with validation and string formatting methods.

classes.name: ProductSearch.ProductFieldConstraint
classes.description: Implements a product search constraint based on a specific product field and keyword filtering.

classes.name: ProductSearch.ResultSortOrder
classes.description: Abstract class for defining different result sort orders, includes subclasses for specific sorting strategies.

classes.name: ProductSearch.SortKeywordRelevancy
classes.description: Sorts products based on keyword relevancy, adjusting order and fields to select accordingly.

classes.name: ProductSearch.SortProductField
classes.description: Sorts products by a specified product field, with options for ascending or descending order.

classes.name: ProductSearch.SortProductPrice
classes.description: Sorts products based on price, with configuration for price type, currency, store group, and order.

classes.name: ProductSearch.SortProductFeature
classes.description: Sorts products by a specific product feature type, with ascending or descending order options.

methods.name: parametricKeywordSearch
methods.description: Performs a product search based on feature IDs, keywords, category, and visit info, returning sorted product IDs.

methods.name: searchProducts
methods.description: Executes a search with specified constraints and sorting order, returns list of product IDs.

methods.name: getAllSubCategoryIds
methods.description: Recursively collects all subcategory IDs for a given category, including the specified category.
